lane: exploratory; no assigned method paragraph; NOT preregistered
hypothesis: Restricting dots to footprint pixels more than 3 px from every nine-site champion dot yields a file that is unique versus the nine focus sites while retaining detectable holdout signal from a label-free detector.
mechanism: Label-free features (19-band geophysics + LiDAR scarp/arc channels from the prepared cache) feed a histogram gradient-boosting classifier trained only on visible catalogue positives inside buffered training regions. The top 37,654 pixels are emitted per quadrant share, ranked after the champion-distance mask.
named_non_fault_mimic: Linear artefacts in gridded magnetic, gravity or DEM products (flight-line and stitching seams, road cut-and-fill, drainage incision) that look like fault edges but are not faults.
